description:
Hi! We are a team of developers passionate about space tech and healthcare.

For this challenge, we are building an interactive astronaut health dashboard with dynamic vital charts, color-coded alerts, and a clickable body map to track spaceflight risks.

Mission: Build an intuitive tool that keeps deep-space crews safe.

We are a closed team and already full. We are NOT looking for new members. Thanks for checking us out!
summary:
NOVA SHIELD

See the Hidden. Predict the Risk. Protect the Crew.

NOVA SHIELD is an AI-assisted environmental and astronaut health monitoring system proposed for long-duration space missions.

It combines three integrated modules:

- AEROMAP – Environmental Intelligence: Monitors CO₂, temperature, humidity, and airflow across spacecraft zones, identifying unusual environmental changes.
- ASTRA-SYNC – Health Impact Intelligence: Connects environmental trends with relevant health information, including sleep, fatigue, concentration, and well-being.
- ZENVITA – Wearable Health Integration: Optionally displays wearable measurements such as heart rate, HRV, SpO₂, sleep, and activity.

The system aims to detect developing environmental conditions, identify possible contributing factors, estimate future trends, and help astronauts and authorised Mission Control personnel review relevant health information.

Its dashboard includes spacecraft zone mapping, predictive warnings, historical charts, health indicators, an action-review checklist, and post-action verification.

NOVA SHIELD is a proposed decision-support prototype, not a medical device or replacement for existing spacecraft safety systems. All demonstration readings are simulated. Safety-critical decisions remain with authorised humans.

Challenge: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions
Event: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
details:
Project: ASTRAVITA

App: Nova Shield

Team: OrbitFit

NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Challenge: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions

Live App: https://mmabyadh-cmd.github.io/novashield/

GitHub: https://github.com/mmabyadh-cmd/novashield

WHAT DOES IT DO / HOW DOES IT WORK?

ASTRAVITA — Nova Shield is an AI-powered environmental + health intelligence system for long-duration space missions. It is ONE app, not three separate apps.

It answers 6 questions in seconds for every alert: WHERE? WHAT? WHY? WHAT NEXT? WHAT TO DO? DID IT IMPROVE?

It has 3 equal core modules + 3 supporting stations, all in one dashboard:

1. AEROMAP — Environment (6 zones, all equal)

Monitors zone-level CO2, temperature, humidity, airflow, pressure, VOC, particulates, noise and light for: Sleeping Compartment, Lab, Exercise, Galley / Kitchen, Control, Medical. In microgravity, natural convection is reduced, so a cabin average hides local pockets. AEROMAP shows each zone separately.

Live Demo: Sleeping Compartment YELLOW — CO2 850 ppm, Airflow 0.12 m/s Down 30%, Temp 23.1°C. After the crew checks the vent + filter and clicks Mark as Done, it verifies: CO2 610 ppm GREEN, Recovery 68 to 82. Full audit trail: 08:00 Alert → 08:05 Acknowledged → 08:20 Inspection → 08:40 Verified.

2. ASTRA-SYNC — Health Impact

Connects environment timing with health timing. It does NOT claim the environment causes a body change. It shows association only. Example: CREW-001 Commander — Sleep 5.8h, Recovery 68, HRV Down 18%, HR 72, SpO2 97% on the same nights CO2 was high. The other 5 crew stayed GREEN, Recovery 83-88.

3. ZENVITA — Full Wearable Body Data (Opt-in, No Delivery)

Complete wearable app inside Nova Shield.

- Dashboard: Health Score, Recovery, Sleep, HRV, SpO2, HR, Steps, Calories, Water, Mood for CREW-001 to CREW-006 (crew selector)

- Sleep Lab: Last night 5.8 h, Deep 14%, REM 18%, Onset 28 min, Wakes 3, Quality 62%, 7-day trend 7.5 • 5.8 h falling

- Recovery & Strain: Recovery, Strain 72, Readiness Low, Resting HR 68

- Activity & Exercise: Steps 4200, Active 28 min, Treadmill 20 min, Resistance 15 min, Add Workout

- Nutrition & Hydration: Calories 2100/2600, Water 1.8L/2.5L, Add Meal, Add 250ml Water, Macros

- Mind & Well-being: Mood / Energy / Focus / Stress check-in 1-5 + Save, Breathing 4-7-8 timer, Journal

- History: 7-day table for Sleep, HRV, Recovery, HR, SpO2

- Privacy: Opt-in only, no audio/video, Data stays local, Share trends with Crew Medical only

4. Space Smart Kitchen Station

Galley + Nutrition Hub, onboard inventory only, no delivery, no ordering from Earth. No bread in space — crumbs float. Tortillas only.

Inventory — Real NASA / ISS Food Types:

Main (Thermostabilized pouches): Shrimp Cocktail 12, Beef Stroganoff 10, Chicken Teriyaki 11, Spaghetti with Meat Sauce 9, Grilled Chicken 8.

Breakfast (Freeze-Dried): Scrambled Eggs 14, Oatmeal with Raisins 12, Granola 10.

Sides (Freeze-Dried / Thermostabilized): Macaroni & Cheese 12, Mashed Potatoes 13, Rice Pilaf 10, Corn 9, Green Beans 9.

Bread + Spread: Tortillas 18, Peanut Butter 6, Cheese Spread 7.

Snacks (Natural Form / Freeze-Dried): Trail Mix 15, Almonds 10, Dried Apricots 4 LOW STOCK, Freeze-Dried Strawberries 9.

Desserts: Brownies 8, Freeze-Dried Ice Cream 7.

Drinks (Freeze-Dried): Coffee 20, Orange Juice 14, Tea 16.

Condiments: Ketchup, Hot Sauce, Salt & Pepper 12.

Water: Water Pouches 40 — for rehydration + drinking.

Search + filter, expiry dates, low-stock warnings. Example: Dried Apricots 4 = LOW STOCK warning.

Today's Menu for each crew: Breakfast 450 kcal, Lunch 750 kcal, Dinner 500 kcal, Snack 190 kcal. Total 1890 kcal / day.

Example Day: Breakfast — Scrambled Eggs + Tortilla + Coffee 450 kcal. Lunch — Shrimp Cocktail + Rice Pilaf 750 kcal. Dinner — Beef Stroganoff + Mashed Potatoes 500 kcal. Snack — Trail Mix 190 kcal.

Choose a Meal from Space Kitchen: Astronaut chooses a meal from what is already onboard. No ordering. Choosing takes 1 portion from stock, logs it in ZENVITA Nutrition, and updates Food Status + Survival live.

Food Status + Survival: Food Left 592,800 kcal, Water Left 920L. Calculation: 592,800 ÷ (6 crew × 2,600 kcal/day) = 38 days of food. 920L ÷ (6 × 2.5L/day) = 61 days water. Food runs out first. So the crew can live 38 days. What-If Simulator: change crew size or ration (Normal / Ration / Emergency) to see new survival days.

Recipe Builder: Pick 3 ingredients → Suggest recipe (e.g. Tortilla + Peanut Butter + Freeze-Dried Strawberries = Space PB & Berry Wrap 450 kcal) + Cook Log → Syncs to ZENVITA Nutrition.

Food Safety: Fridge 3.5°C GREEN, Freezer -18°C GREEN, Hygiene checklist. Waste: Food waste 0.2 kg, Recycling 92%, Water recycling 92%. Equipment: Rehydration Station, Food Warmer, Dispenser — all GREEN.

5. Exercise Station: Treadmill, Cycle Ergometer, Resistance device, weekly plan, equipment status, syncs to ZENVITA.

6. Sleep Station: Sleep environment (CO2, Temp, Noise, Light), sleep schedule for all 6 crew, sleep hygiene checklist.

5 AI MODELS — VISIBLE IN ALL MODES:

Model 1 Pattern: 82% — Rising CO2 pattern detected

Model 2 Prediction: YELLOW again in 90 min (Range 75-110 min) if not fixed

Model 3 Cause: Reduced ventilation 82% / Filter load 11% / Other 7%

Model 4 Health: Sleep Down 28%, HRV Down 18%

The same 4 models appear in Dashboard, Astronaut, Mission Control, Crew, Health, Body, ZENVITA and Kitchen modes. Never hidden.

WHAT BENEFITS DOES IT HAVE?

- Early warning: Predicts risk 90 minutes before the threshold, not after.

- Zone-level truth: Finds hidden local CO2 pockets that cabin averages hide.

- Faster decisions: WHERE / WHAT / WHY / NEXT / ACTION / IMPROVED in one screen.

- One app: Environment + Health + Body + Kitchen + Exercise + Sleep together, no switching apps.

- Verified action: Mark as Done proves improvement with before/after numbers, not just an alert that disappears.

- Equal coverage: 6 zones equal, 6 astronauts equal, 3 health areas (Sleep / Physical / Mental) equal.

- Human in control: AI suggests, human approves. AI never auto-acts on safety actions.

- Private and resilient: Opt-in, no audio/video, offline-first, works with communication delay to Earth.

WHAT IS THE INTENDED IMPACT?

To make long-duration missions safer when Earth cannot help instantly. To protect sleep, recovery and daily performance, not just to sound alarms. To support independent health monitoring for Lunar Gateway, Moon, and Mars missions, where delays range from minutes to tens of minutes, and the crew must decide alone.

On Earth, the same logic helps submarines, isolated research stations, hospitals and remote workplaces where air + health + food + sleep are connected.

Vision: See the Hidden. Predict the Risk. Protect the Crew.

WHAT TOOLS, CODING LANGUAGES, HARDWARE, OR SOFTWARE DID YOU USE?

- Languages: HTML (single-file web app, index.html)

- Fonts / Design: Inter — one font for all text, spacious layout, high-contrast cards for readability

- Platform: GitHub Pages (public, no login) — Live: https://mmabyadh-cmd.github.io/novashield/

- Code: GitHub repo GitHub.com/mmabyadh-cmd/novashield (MIT, public)

- Data: Simulated environmental sensor data + simulated wearable data, modelled on NASA ECLSS concepts and NASA-STD-3001 human factors guidance. No real astronaut data used.

- AI Logic: Rule-based logic + pattern detection + trend analysis + confidence scoring (prototype logic, clearly labelled with % confidence and ranges, not a black box)

- Conceptual hardware foundation: Existing spacecraft sensors (CO2, temp, humidity, airflow, pressure) + commercial wearable sensors (HR, HRV, SpO2, sleep, steps) + galley equipment (rehydration station, warmer, fridge/freezer). No new hardware required for the prototype.

- Presentation: 7-slide Google Slides demo (ASTRAVITA / Nova Shield / Team OrbitFit)

HOW IS YOUR PROJECT CREATIVE?

Most systems monitor spacecraft OR astronauts separately, and only alert after a threshold. ASTRAVITA is creative because it does 5 things together:

1. Zone-level + Prediction: It finds WHERE the problem is and WHEN it will return, not just that a threshold was crossed.

2. Environment + Body + Kitchen + Sleep in one loop: Air → Sleep → Recovery → Food → Exercise → Air. A poor sleep night, a low recovery score, a low-stock food item and a high-CO2 zone are shown together, not in separate tools.

3. Verified loop: Alert → Action → Mark as Done → Before/After proof. Judges and crew can see improvement, not just warnings.

4. Transparent AI: Every AI claim shows its confidence and range, and health claims are labelled association only.

5. Honest, human-centred design: Privacy-first, opt-in, offline-first, equal importance to every zone, crew member and health area. SpO2 does NOT measure CO2 — we state this clearly and never merge the two.

WHAT FACTORS DID YOUR TEAM CONSIDER?

Team OrbitFit considered:

- Astronaut safety first: Early warning, verified actions, human approval, never auto-action on safety.

- Scientific honesty: Simulated data clearly labelled, decision-support only, not a medical device, association not causation, SpO2 ≠ CO2, confidence + ranges shown.

- Privacy: Opt-in wearable sharing, no audio/video, share trends with Crew Medical only, local/offline data.

- Communication delay: Offline-first, crew can decide without Earth.

- Usability: One app, one font, spacious layout, big numbers, 6 questions answered in seconds, works on mobile + desktop, no login.

- Compatibility: Works with existing sensors / wearables / galley equipment, no new hardware needed.

- Equality: 6 zones equal, 6 astronauts equal, Sleep / Physical / Mental equal, AEROMAP / ASTRA-SYNC / ZENVITA equal.

- Practical limits: Prototype uses simulated data; future work needs real telemetry, real wearable validation, personal baselines, radiation / noise / lighting, and specialist medical validation before any real use.

- Food and daily life: Nutrition, hydration, waste, food safety and exercise are part of health, not extras — so Smart Kitchen, Exercise and Sleep Stations are included, with no delivery feature.

ZenVita AI App is a companion model originally built for a separate hackathon challenge on nutrition and lifestyle. It was first generated with Bolt AI, then I personally edited, corrected, and adapted the code, data, and logic for use inside ASTRAVITA

In ASTRAVITA, ZenVita is not a separate app. It is one integrated module inside Nova Shield — for body data, sleep, food, and mind — rebuilt for astronauts, with an onboard-only Space Kitchen and real NASA/ISS food.
